sentences.text:
Order 
This Court by order dated 22.02.2023 in W.P.No.112699/2019 disposed of the writ petition with the following direction.

"In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and rival submissions, the respondents are hereby directed to address the grievances of the petitioners and consider their representation dated 28.02.2019 at Annexure-E2 and pass appropriate order in accordance with law, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order."
2. This Court directed the respondents to address the grievance of the petitioner by considering their representation dated 28.02.2019.
On appearance, accused No.3 filed an affidavit enclosing one document stating that the Department of Railways have not acquired any excess land.
Hence, the question of paying compensation would not arise.
